attchmntText: The Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 as recommended by the Audit Committee at its board meeting held on 12.11.2026. Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 and Limited Review Report of Auditors are enclosed.
voiceSummary: The Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr V S Murthy as the Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel, effective from the afternoon of 12.11.2026. Mr Murthy holds Membership No. 31918 of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. He previously joined the Company as Deputy General Manager Finance and Accounts on 18.09.2026. Mr A Madhan Mohan was relieved from the position of Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel with effect from the afternoon of 12.11.2026. Mr Madhan Mohan continues to hold the position of General Manager Plant. The Limited Review Report of Auditors is enclosed with the announcement.
